method: Visual review of the recorded full-task storyboard grids, supplemented by unsmoothed 200 Hz physical-state quality comparisons. Full-task video files are supplied separately; no time scaling or state interpolation.
observations: Both samples visibly acquire, lift, walk with, place and release the original largebox.
Walking posture, foot alternation, box retention and placement appear consistent with the preserved Goal 6 gait.
Post-grasp lifting has visibly earlier coordinated pelvis/box rise and altered body/arm posture.
qualification: Sparse visual review cannot rule out every short transient; full physical velocity/acceleration/contact metrics and the unchanged validation gates provide the complementary checks.
